import io.xberg.tslp.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"ruby\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("require 'json'\n\nclass Greeter\n  def greet(name)\n    \"Hello #{name}\"\n  end\nend\n", config)
    println(result.language)
    println(result.structure)
    println(result.structure.first().kind)
    println(result.metrics.totalLines)
    println(result.metrics.errorCount)
}
